title: Chen Nian's Blood Sacrifice
next_chapter_hook: In the instant Chen Nian fell, an ancient call echoed from the depths of the Forbidden Grounds—that voice like a slumbering beast awakening after ten thousand years, its gaze fixed upon the siblings bound by blood...

text.content: After Ye Qing departed, the demonic path mist still lingered in the ruins. Chen Ji sat alone among the broken walls and scattered stones, his fingertips unconsciously tracing the edge of the Tianji Record Fragment. The secret between his father and Ye Qing could wait for now, because at this moment he sensed another familiar presence—a resonance from deep within his bloodline that could not be deceived. "Nian'er..." he murmured softly, his brow furrowing. A powerful sense of unease rose in his heart, as if something he most dreaded was unfolding.

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled violently, and blurry images emerged on its yellowed pages—Chen Nian's figure, rushing desperately into some Forbidden Grounds shrouded in blood-red light. Chen Ji's pupils constricted; he recognized the region's characteristics: the Ancient Blood Altar, the imprisonment ground the Holy Sect used to cage those with Heavenly Fate Key bloodlines. "How could she..." His voice quivered, his fingers gripping the fragment's edge so tightly his knuckles turned white. In the vision, Chen Nian's gaze was resolute and heroic, as if she had long prepared herself for death.

dialogue.content: "Brother, I sense you." Chen Nian's voice rang directly in his consciousness, carrying a weary yet unwavering tone. "Don't stop me. This is the only thing I can do for you." Her figure flashed past in the vision, and Chen Ji clearly saw the deep gashes on her wrists—visible to the bone—marks left from using her essence blood to forcibly unseal the Forbidden Grounds.

text.content: Chen Ji surged to his feet, a suppressed growl escaping his throat. He attempted to use the Tianji Record to stop Chen Nian, only to find that no matter how he channeled his Heavenly Fate Value, the images on the fragment would not change by a single detail. This was his greatest fear—Tianji Record could foresee the future, yet it could not alter the choices of those closest to him. He slammed his fist into the stone pillar beside him, fragments scattering, crimson seeping through his knuckles, but he seemed to feel no pain. "Chen Nian! Stop!"

In the depths of the Forbidden Grounds, Chen Nian stepped into the core area of the Blood Altar. The stone walls around her were inscribed with cryptic runes, glowing with an eerie crimson light. She could feel the Heavenly Fate Key bloodline within her resonating with those runes—the chains the Holy Sect had planted in her long ago, now to be severed by her own hands. "Brother, you've always protected me," she whispered, her voice echoing through the empty altar. "This time, let Nian'er protect you." She raised her wrist and drew the first cut without hesitation.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji was frantic in the ruins. The Tianji Record's vision transmitted Chen Nian's every move in real time. He had to make a choice—whether to forcibly interrupt the Tianji Record's foresight to preserve his Heavenly Fate Value, or to expend everything to witness his sister's sacrifice?

choices.text: Exhaust Heavenly Fate Value to Track
choices.description: Burn all Heavenly Fate Value to lock onto Chen Nian's position, catching every detail, regardless of the cost
choices.visible_reward: Fully witness Chen Nian's blood sacrifice process, understand the complete secret of the Heavenly Fate Key
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value will drop to dangerous threshold; subsequent combat capability greatly reduced

text.content: Under Chen Ji's urging, the Tianji Record Fragment erupted with blinding golden light—an extreme consumption he had never attempted before. Within the golden light, every细微 movement of Chen Nian was rendered in perfect clarity before his eyes—including the bitter yet relieved smile at the corner of her lips.

choices.text: Preserve Heavenly Fate Value and Seek Another Way
choices.description: Preserve strength to find other methods to stop Chen Nian; perhaps there is still a turning point
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate Value for subsequent actions, but may miss critical information
choices.risk_hint: Cannot precisely know Chen Nian's specific location or the altar's operational method

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully restrained his impulse and put away the Tianji Record, but the resonance within his bloodline grew ever stronger. That was Chen Nian calling to him, pulling him toward the direction of the Forbidden Grounds.

Under the golden light's illumination, Chen Ji saw the Blood Alar's full appearance. It was a circular altar constructed from white jade and black obsidian, its surface covered in complex formation rune patterns, with a dagger radiating cold幽光 floating at its center. Chen Nian stood at the altar's edge, her blood dripping from her fingertips onto the patterns, each drop triggering a faint circle of red light. "The ancient blood sacrifice requires the blood of the Heavenly Fate Key as the catalyst," she murmured to herself. "Blood for blood, life for life."

Chen Ji finally understood Chen Nian's intention—she would use her own bloodline as the price, forcibly activating the life-force sealed within the altar to extend the life of her brother, who was on the verge of Heavenly Fate backlash. The Key bloodline the Holy Sect had planted in her back then had now become the key to saving him. He rushed frantically toward the Forbidden Grounds, his True Qi surging wildly within him, yet it still felt far too slow. "Chen Nian! Don't!" His frantic shouts echoed across the wilderness but could not penetrate the重重禁制.

dialogue.content: "Brother, I actually knew all along." Chen Nian's voice pierced the void, gently resonating in his heart. "I knew you were the heir of the Tianji Record, knew you've been protecting me in secret, knew you've been scheming for ten years to find me. The Holy Sect treated me as a tool, but only you know—first and foremost, I am Chen family's daughter, your sister." Her eyes glistened with tears, yet she smiled more brilliantly than ever. "Letting my brother live well is the one thing Nian'er has always wanted most."

text.content: The Blood Alar's runes were illuminated one by one by Chen Nian's blood, and the entire altar began to shudder violently. She could feel her life-force being drawn away bit by bit, transforming into pure blood-colored light drifting into the void. Gritting her teeth, she formed ancient hand seals—the secret technique passed down through Chen family's ancestors, a forbidden art only usable by pure-blood descendants of the Heavenly Fate Key. She would convert all her life essence into nourishment for her brother's survival.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's consciousness had already traced Chen Nian's position, but the Blood Alar's barrier blocked his path. He had to make a choice—whether to forcefully breach the barrier to interrupt the ritual, or to watch his sister sacrifice herself?

choices.description: Tear open a crack with the power of Tianji Record, interrupting the blood sacrifice at any cost
choices.visible_reward: May interrupt the blood sacrifice, saving Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The barrier backlash may severely wound Chen Ji, and the consequences of interrupting the blood sacrifice are unpredictable

text.content: Chen Ji pressed the Tianji Record Fragment against his palm and slashed at the barrier's light curtain with Heavenly Fate Value as his blade. Blinding arcs of electricity coursed through his body, the agony nearly causing him to black out, but he clenched his teeth and tore open a crack through sheer will.

choices.description: Respect Chen Nian's will, don't interrupt the ritual, but attempt to provide support through blood resonance
choices.visible_reward: Complete blood resonance with Chen Nian, uncovering the ultimate secret of the Chen family bloodline
choices.risk_hint: May only watch Chen Nian walk toward sacrifice

text.content: Chen Ji did not force his way through. Instead, he sat cross-legged outside the barrier, pressing his palm against the light curtain. The power of blood resonance was instantly established, and he felt Chen Nian's scorching and pure life-force within her.

The moment Chen Ji's blood resonance was established, Chen Nian shuddered throughout her body. She sensed her brother's presence—warm and steadfast, like that figure who always stood in front of her when they were young. "Brother, you came." Her voice carried a哽咽 yet she did not cease her movements. "Don't interrupt me. Let me finish this. This is Nian'er's own choice. Please respect me." Her eyes were full of pleading but held no trace of retreat. Chen Ji's hand hovered in mid-air, ultimately failing to reach out.

dialogue.content: "Brother, do you know? Our bloodline conceals an enormous secret." Chen Nian's voice grew weaker, yet her words grew clearer. "The Heavenly Fate Key is not merely a key—it is also the bridge connecting the Heavenly Dao and the Mortal Dao. The Holy Sect wanted to use me to open the door to the Forbidden Lands, but they didn't know—the true key works both ways. It can open, and it can also seal." She lifted her pale face. "Brother, the complete form of the Tianji Record requires this seal to suppress its backlash. And I am the fragment of that seal."

text.content: Chen Ji was struck as if by lightning. The complete form of the Tianji Record required a seal to suppress backlash—Mo Xiansheng had never told him this, yet Chen Nian had filled this missing piece with her life. He finally understood why the Tianji Record Fragment had chosen him, why Chen Nian had been taken by the Holy Sect, why all of this seemed predestined. His sister was never a burden—she was the missing puzzle piece he was fated to find. "Nian'er..." His voice choked, his eyes reddening for the first time.

The Blood Alar's light reached its peak. Chen Nian's body began to turn translucent, like gauze pierced by moonlight. Her essence blood transformed into countless tiny points of light, rising from the altar, coalescing into a dazzling pillar of blood-colored light that shot straight toward the heavens. The life-force contained within that pillar was so concentrated it was suffocating—even Chen Ji beyond the barrier could feel that warm and surging vitality. Chen Nian turned her head, revealing a relieved smile toward him, her lips parting to silently utter three words—"Live on."

choice.prompt: The blood-colored pillar descended from the heavens and dove directly into Chen Ji's body. He felt unprecedented power flooding into his meridians, but at the same time felt Chen Nian's life rapidly draining away. This was the final choice—accept this power and let his sister disappear forever, or forcibly sever the connection and share life and death with her?

choices.description: Accept Chen Nian's complete gift, allowing her sacrifice to be fully realized
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete Heavenly Fate Key fragment; Tianji Record's backlash suppression greatly enhanced
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian will completely dissipate from heaven and earth

text.content: Chen Ji fell to his knees, both hands raised high to catch that blood-colored pillar. The moment the light entered his body, the Tianji Record Fragment automatically flipped open, revealing the hidden next page—bearing the complete diagram of the Heavenly Fate Key.

choices.description: Use his own body as a vessel to divert Chen Nian's power, preserving a trace of her true spirit
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian will not completely dissipate; there may be a chance of reconstruction
choices.risk_hint: Diverting will weaken the power amplification and may encounter unknown risks

text.content: Chen Ji bit through his tongue, using his essence blood as a guide to forcibly介入 the pillar. His body convulsed violently, the power flooding into his meridians nearly bursting him apart, but he死死不放 that wisp of faint true spirit.

After the pillar dissipated, Chen Ji knelt at the altar's edge, both hands cradling a warm, blood-colored Jade Pendant. That was the only trace Chen Nian left—her true spirit imprisoned within this Jade Pendant, temporarily preventing dissipation. "Nian'er..." He clutched the Jade Pendant tightly, his knuckles white. "I swear I will find a way to reconstruct your physical body." His voice was low and resolute, his grief gradually replaced by deeper obsession. The Holy Sect, the Eye of Heavenly Dao, Ling Yuan—all who stood in his way would be settled.

Just then, an ancient tremor came from the depths of the Forbidden Grounds. That sound was vast and distant, like a slumbering primordial beast awakening, or perhaps some long-sealed barrier being triggered. Chen Ji猛地抬头, sensing a familiar yet terrifying aura spreading from the Forbidden Grounds' core—a power of the same source as the Tianji Record, yet twisted into an entirely different form. "Eye of Heavenly Dao..." he murmured, a cold light flickering in his eyes. "So you've been waiting for me here all along."

From the crack in the barrier seeped a deep purple light, accompanied by chilling whispers. Chen Ji tucked Chen Nian's Jade Pendant close to his body and slowly rose to his feet. His gaze had regained its usual composure and depth, yet the hand gripping the Tianji Record trembled slightly—not from fear, but from rage. "I originally intended to uncover your true face step by step," he said to the void, his voice terrifyingly calm. "But you touched my sister. This time, I will make you pay the price." New pages on the Tianji Record Fragment were slowly emerging—a map he had never seen before—the route to the core of the Forbidden Grounds.
